body: A Registered Office Address is the statutory address of a limited company or LLP. You must provide registered office address details for Companies House when you incorporate a limited company or LLP in the UK. Government agencies (such as Companies House and HMRC), will then post all of your official company mail to this address. Project a professional image by utilizing a prestigious london registered office address. It will also be disclosed on the public register of companies. Do keep in mind that –
Registered office address details must be displayed on all company stationery and websites.
It prevents unsolicited mail and visitors from arriving at your home address.
If you are from overseas you will need a UK address for your registered office.
A registered office address must be a full physical address (not a PO Box Number)
**Importance of a registered office address service**

It is a legal requirement for all limited companies and LLPs. It proves beneficial when receiving official government mail from governing agencies, such as the Companies House and HMRC. It also protects your residential address from being displayed on the public register of companies.

**Forwarding of registered office address mail : **All mail from UK government entities, as well as court papers, will be scanned and emailed to you within one working day for free.General commercial correspondence is not handled by this service.

**Facts to remember :** If you wish to use this address for more than one company, a separate registered office address service should be purchased for each . Official government mail is classified as mail from all UK government bodies, as well as Court documents.
